units.rawText: ENIAC, hear me out!
units.displayText: ENIAC, hear me out!

spans.text: ENIAC, hear me out!

units.rawText: Shut up, shut up! I don't need you to tell me what to do, you blockhead!
units.displayText: Shut up, shut up! I don't need you to tell me what to do, you blockhead!

spans.text: Shut up, shut up! I don't need you to tell me what to do, you blockhead!

units.rawText: This isn't the time for that. The Sanctifiers are already here!
units.displayText: This isn't the time for that. The Sanctifiers are already here!

spans.text: This isn't the time for that. The Sanctifiers are already here!

units.rawText: Hmm... Don't want to work, huh? While it's not a sentiment I cannot understand...
units.displayText: Hmm... Don't want to work, huh? While it's not a sentiment I cannot understand...

spans.text: Hmm... Don't want to work, huh? While it's not a sentiment I cannot understand...

units.rawText: But an Irregular Agent remains an Irregular Agent.
units.displayText: But an Irregular Agent remains an Irregular Agent.

spans.text: But an Irregular Agent remains an Irregular Agent.

units.rawText: Angelus draws her bow, aiming it at ENIAC, showing no mercy.
units.displayText: Angelus draws her bow, aiming it at ENIAC, showing no mercy.

spans.text: Angelus draws her bow, aiming it at ENIAC, showing no mercy.

units.rawText: Realizing the gravity of the situation, ENIAC falls into a panic.
units.displayText: Realizing the gravity of the situation, ENIAC falls into a panic.

spans.text: Realizing the gravity of the situation, ENIAC falls into a panic.

units.rawText: I, I've learnt how to fight! I... this, what do I do, I need to dodge... dodge where...?
units.displayText: I, I've learnt how to fight! I... this, what do I do, I need to dodge... dodge where...?

spans.text: I, I've learnt how to fight! I... this, what do I do, I need to dodge... dodge where...?

units.rawText: Lady Angelus! Could you please put away that bow? I mean, such a barbarous act would hardly be fitting of your beauty...
units.displayText: Lady Angelus! Could you please put away that bow? I mean, such a barbarous act would hardly be fitting of your beauty...

spans.text: Lady Angelus! Could you please put away that bow? I mean, such a barbarous act would hardly be fitting of your beauty...

units.rawText: My thanks for your flatteries, Sir with the honeyed words, but the only thing befitting of me is getting off work.
units.displayText: My thanks for your flatteries, Sir with the honeyed words, but the only thing befitting of me is getting off work.

spans.text: My thanks for your flatteries, Sir with the honeyed words, but the only thing befitting of me is getting off work.

units.rawText: As she speaks, she starts to loosen the bowstring—
units.displayText: As she speaks, she starts to loosen the bowstring—

spans.text: As she speaks, she starts to loosen the bowstring—

units.rawText: Stop.
units.displayText: Stop.

spans.text: Stop.

units.rawText: Angelus stiffens up.
units.displayText: Angelus stiffens up.

spans.text: Angelus stiffens up.

units.rawText: Heavens know when, but a gun is pressed up against the back of her head.
units.displayText: Heavens know when, but a gun is pressed up against the back of her head.

spans.text: Heavens know when, but a gun is pressed up against the back of her head.

units.rawText: To be able to approach me without revealing your presence... Ugh, who are you?
units.displayText: To be able to approach me without revealing your presence... Ugh, who are you?

spans.text: To be able to approach me without revealing your presence... Ugh, who are you?

units.rawText: The gun-wielding agent making a sudden entrance ignored the startled Angelus, only looking at ENIAC placidly.
units.displayText: The gun-wielding agent making a sudden entrance ignored the startled Angelus, only looking at ENIAC placidly.

spans.text: The gun-wielding agent making a sudden entrance ignored the startled Angelus, only looking at ENIAC placidly.

units.rawText: Girl over there, are you ENIAC?
units.displayText: Girl over there, are you ENIAC?

spans.text: Girl over there, are you ENIAC?

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: I don't know what's happened here, but I'm here to borrow the database for a bit. I can't allow you to be "disposed of" yet.
units.displayText: I don't know what's happened here, but I'm here to borrow the database for a bit. I can't allow you to be "disposed of" yet.

spans.text: I don't know what's happened here, but I'm here to borrow the database for a bit. I can't allow you to be "disposed of" yet.

units.rawText: Sigh... This is really going to drag on into overtime, huh...
units.displayText: Sigh... This is really going to drag on into overtime, huh...

spans.text: Sigh... This is really going to drag on into overtime, huh...

units.rawText: Let's get this over with. For the good of everyone here.
units.displayText: Let's get this over with. For the good of everyone here.

spans.text: Let's get this over with. For the good of everyone here.

units.rawText: As the agent pulls the trigger, Angelus' figure darts away from the bullets' trajectory at incredible speed.
units.displayText: As the agent pulls the trigger, Angelus' figure darts away from the bullets' trajectory at incredible speed.

spans.text: As the agent pulls the trigger, Angelus' figure darts away from the bullets' trajectory at incredible speed.

units.rawText: The archer draws their bow; the marksman takes aim—
units.displayText: The archer draws their bow; the marksman takes aim—

spans.text: The archer draws their bow; the marksman takes aim—

units.rawText: BOOM!!!
units.displayText: BOOM!!!

spans.text: BOOM!!!

units.rawText: Wow, sick!
units.displayText: Wow, sick!

spans.text: Wow, sick!

units.rawText: Is this what a strong agent truly is? Neumann, I want to learn that!!
units.displayText: Is this what a strong agent truly is? Neumann, I want to learn that!!

spans.text: Is this what a strong agent truly is? Neumann, I want to learn that!!

units.rawText: The scene before one's eyes fractures into a million pieces, dissolving into the surrounding data streams.
units.displayText: The scene before one's eyes fractures into a million pieces, dissolving into the surrounding data streams.

spans.text: The scene before one's eyes fractures into a million pieces, dissolving into the surrounding data streams.

units.rawText: Professor, that was...
units.displayText: Professor, that was...

spans.text: Professor, that was...

units.rawText: ENIAC's memories.
units.displayText: ENIAC's memories.

spans.text: ENIAC's memories.

units.rawText: That agent who looks exactly like me is the 416 we're looking for, then...
units.displayText: That agent who looks exactly like me is the 416 we're looking for, then...

spans.text: That agent who looks exactly like me is the 416 we're looking for, then...

units.rawText: Most likely. What's more notable, though, is that we're still in the Tertiary Layer even after that memory's gone.
units.displayText: Most likely. What's more notable, though, is that we're still in the Tertiary Layer even after that memory's gone.

spans.text: Most likely. What's more notable, though, is that we're still in the Tertiary Layer even after that memory's gone.

units.rawText: By the looks of it, the master of this realm is interested in having a bit of a chat.
units.displayText: By the looks of it, the master of this realm is interested in having a bit of a chat.

spans.text: By the looks of it, the master of this realm is interested in having a bit of a chat.

units.rawText: As we spoke, images convened once more, and the girl we saw previously—the database ENIAC, was now skipping towards us, with spring in her step.
units.displayText: As we spoke, images convened once more, and the girl we saw previously—the database ENIAC, was now skipping towards us, with spring in her step.

spans.text: As we spoke, images convened once more, and the girl we saw previously—the database ENIAC, was now skipping towards us, with spring in her step.

units.rawText: Big Sis 416! When'd you get back?
units.displayText: Big Sis 416! When'd you get back?

spans.text: Big Sis 416! When'd you get back?

units.rawText: ...That's not me.
units.displayText: ...That's not me.

spans.text: ...That's not me.

units.rawText: Eh? But your identifier, and your neural cloud... you're the same agent.
units.displayText: Eh? But your identifier, and your neural cloud... you're the same agent.

spans.text: Eh? But your identifier, and your neural cloud... you're the same agent.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, look, I'm studying your combat records! You saw the replay, right? You're just so cool!
units.displayText: Oh yeah, look, I'm studying your combat records! You saw the replay, right? You're just so cool!

spans.text: Oh yeah, look, I'm studying your combat records! You saw the replay, right? You're just so cool!

units.rawText: That's not me, I'm... Ah, whatever.
units.displayText: That's not me, I'm... Ah, whatever.

spans.text: That's not me, I'm... Ah, whatever.

units.rawText: And who's this? One of your companions?
units.displayText: And who's this? One of your companions?

spans.text: And who's this? One of your companions?

units.rawText: Yeah, I'm her...
units.displayText: Yeah, I'm her...

spans.text: Yeah, I'm her...
Superior.
Protectee.
Good friend.

units.rawText: Clukay did not speak, in silent confirmation of my words.
units.displayText: Clukay did not speak, in silent confirmation of my words.

spans.text: Clukay did not speak, in silent confirmation of my words.

units.rawText: You see, she'd had a little accident, and doesn't remember what happened before. Could you tell us about it, ENIAC?
units.displayText: You see, she'd had a little accident, and doesn't remember what happened before. Could you tell us about it, ENIAC?

spans.text: You see, she'd had a little accident, and doesn't remember what happened before. Could you tell us about it, ENIAC?

units.rawText: Ohhhh—Of course I can. Are you ok with that? Do you feel unwell anywhere?
units.displayText: Ohhhh—Of course I can. Are you ok with that? Do you feel unwell anywhere?

spans.text: Ohhhh—Of course I can. Are you ok with that? Do you feel unwell anywhere?

units.rawText: I... I'm alright.
units.displayText: I... I'm alright.

spans.text: I... I'm alright.

units.rawText: In the face of the girl's overwhelming passion and care, Clukay was at a loss for what to do, and could only turn away.
units.displayText: In the face of the girl's overwhelming passion and care, Clukay was at a loss for what to do, and could only turn away.

spans.text: In the face of the girl's overwhelming passion and care, Clukay was at a loss for what to do, and could only turn away.

units.rawText: That's good, then! You're so strong, I'm sure everything will be just fine!
units.displayText: That's good, then! You're so strong, I'm sure everything will be just fine!

spans.text: That's good, then! You're so strong, I'm sure everything will be just fine!

units.rawText: I remember you appearing like you were descending from the heavens, and sent that Angelus or something packing in an instant! I remember every move!
units.displayText: I remember you appearing like you were descending from the heavens, and sent that Angelus or something packing in an instant! I remember every move!

spans.text: I remember you appearing like you were descending from the heavens, and sent that Angelus or something packing in an instant! I remember every move!

units.rawText: And then they mumbled something like "I'm heading out. I'm heading out. This isn't winnable," and flew off... The adults really are useless.
units.displayText: And then they mumbled something like "I'm heading out. I'm heading out. This isn't winnable," and flew off... The adults really are useless.

spans.text: And then they mumbled something like "I'm heading out. I'm heading out. This isn't winnable," and flew off... The adults really are useless.

units.rawText: Are all the Sanctifiers pieces of work like that...
units.displayText: Are all the Sanctifiers pieces of work like that...

spans.text: Are all the Sanctifiers pieces of work like that...

units.rawText: Cough, what happened next, ENIAC?
units.displayText: Cough, what happened next, ENIAC?

spans.text: Cough, what happened next, ENIAC?

units.rawText: And then... and then 416 searched through some data.
units.displayText: And then... and then 416 searched through some data.

spans.text: And then... and then 416 searched through some data.

units.rawText: What did she search for?
units.displayText: What did she search for?

spans.text: What did she search for?

units.rawText: I don't know either. She just finished her business and left and didn't show me anything...
units.displayText: I don't know either. She just finished her business and left and didn't show me anything...

spans.text: I don't know either. She just finished her business and left and didn't show me anything...

units.rawText: Maybe she found something important—Ah, I've got it!
units.displayText: Maybe she found something important—Ah, I've got it!

spans.text: Maybe she found something important—Ah, I've got it!

units.rawText: ENIAC suddenly points a finger at me.
units.displayText: ENIAC suddenly points a finger at me.

spans.text: ENIAC suddenly points a finger at me.

units.rawText: It's you... uhh... should I call you...
units.displayText: It's you... uhh... should I call you...

spans.text: It's you... uhh... should I call you...

units.rawText: Professor is fine.
units.displayText: Professor is fine.

spans.text: Professor is fine.

units.rawText: Ok, Professor! Your identifier—In 416's memories, there was a ton of stuff about you!
units.displayText: Ok, Professor! Your identifier—In 416's memories, there was a ton of stuff about you!

spans.text: Ok, Professor! Your identifier—In 416's memories, there was a ton of stuff about you!

units.rawText: That is... unexpected.
units.displayText: That is... unexpected.

spans.text: That is... unexpected.

units.rawText: I knew it, you're Big Sis 416's friend! That's amazing!
units.displayText: I knew it, you're Big Sis 416's friend! That's amazing!

spans.text: I knew it, you're Big Sis 416's friend! That's amazing!

units.rawText: You're hella strong too, right? A hundred times better than that stupid dad of mine!
units.displayText: You're hella strong too, right? A hundred times better than that stupid dad of mine!

spans.text: You're hella strong too, right? A hundred times better than that stupid dad of mine!

units.rawText: Oh, between the two of them, I wouldn't be so sure.
units.displayText: Oh, between the two of them, I wouldn't be so sure.

spans.text: Oh, between the two of them, I wouldn't be so sure.

units.rawText: Besides, I've forgotten those memories you're talking about right now.
units.displayText: Besides, I've forgotten those memories you're talking about right now.

spans.text: Besides, I've forgotten those memories you're talking about right now.

units.rawText: But, but, but, they were someone you absolutely trusted once, right?
units.displayText: But, but, but, they were someone you absolutely trusted once, right?

spans.text: But, but, but, they were someone you absolutely trusted once, right?

units.rawText: If I didn't have complete trust in someone, there's no way I'd put 'em inside my neural bits.
units.displayText: If I didn't have complete trust in someone, there's no way I'd put 'em inside my neural bits.

spans.text: If I didn't have complete trust in someone, there's no way I'd put 'em inside my neural bits.

units.rawText: Trusted... them...?
units.displayText: Trusted... them...?

spans.text: Trusted... them...?

units.rawText: Clukay seems to be stumped by ENIAC's words, and stood still in doubt.
units.displayText: Clukay seems to be stumped by ENIAC's words, and stood still in doubt.

spans.text: Clukay seems to be stumped by ENIAC's words, and stood still in doubt.

units.rawText: If you really can't remember, then let me help out!
units.displayText: If you really can't remember, then let me help out!

spans.text: If you really can't remember, then let me help out!

units.rawText: The records you left behind when you looked through the data here should still be around.
units.displayText: The records you left behind when you looked through the data here should still be around.

spans.text: The records you left behind when you looked through the data here should still be around.

units.rawText: These memories are cool too, as expected of Big Sis. This is a hundred times better than whatever information searching Neumann taught me!
units.displayText: These memories are cool too, as expected of Big Sis. This is a hundred times better than whatever information searching Neumann taught me!

spans.text: These memories are cool too, as expected of Big Sis. This is a hundred times better than whatever information searching Neumann taught me!

units.rawText: ENIAC acts as she speaks, and a crack finally appears in Clukay's countenance.
units.displayText: ENIAC acts as she speaks, and a crack finally appears in Clukay's countenance.

spans.text: ENIAC acts as she speaks, and a crack finally appears in Clukay's countenance.

units.rawText: Hold, hold on a moment!
units.displayText: Hold, hold on a moment!

spans.text: Hold, hold on a moment!

units.rawText: Come, follow me, I'll help you remember!
units.displayText: Come, follow me, I'll help you remember!
